decisions.title: Add a usage example to the widget README
decisions.problem: widget/README.md documents every flag but shows no example invocation, so a new reader has to piece one together from the flag list before running the tool once.
decisions.solution: Add a fenced code block under a new '## Example' heading, placed directly after '## Usage', showing the single most common invocation.

rationale.choice: One example, one heading, placed right after Usage.
rejected: A full tutorial section: too much weight for a five-minute documentation gap.
An example per flag: turns a small fix into an open-ended documentation project.

decisions.out_of_scope: Rewriting the flag reference table, or adding examples for any other command in the repo.
decisions.verify_fails_today: widget/README.md has no '## Example' heading today, so the grep exits 1.
